# pve_sdn_dry_run (Data Source)

Dry-run of the SDN apply: diff of pending vs current FRR and /etc/network/interfaces.d/sdn configuration on one node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_sdn_dry_run" "example" {
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `frr_diff` (String) The difference between the current and pending FRR configuration.
- `id` (String) Identifier: .
- `interfaces_diff` (String) The difference between the current and pending /etc/network/interfaces.d/sdn configuration.
